:- months(M), #count{ Probe, Destination : launch(Probe, M, Destination) } != 1.

% Each destination is used exactly once
:- destinations(D), #count{ Probe, Month : launch(Probe, Month, D) } != 1.

% Clue 1: Iunsel launched in February (month 2)
:- launch("Iunsel", Month, _), Month != 2.

% Clue 2: Munei is going to Mars
:- launch("Munei", _, Dest), Dest != "Mars".

% Clue 3: Munei launched 1 month after Pluto mission
:- launch("Munei", M_m, _), launch(_, M_p, "Pluto"), M_m != M_p + 1.

% Clue 4.2: Ganymede mission launched in March or is Chano
:- launch(Probe, Month, "Ganymede"), Month != 3, Probe != "Chano".

% Clue 4.3: Pluto mission launched in March or is Chano
:- launch(Probe, Month, "Pluto"), Month != 3, Probe != "Chano".
